note: Near the vendored security-audit (general OWASP assessment and scoring) - this one hardens a TYPO3 installation specifically. Cases lead with the TYPO3 artefact being hardened.

evals.prompt: Review our deployment checklist: Apache LocationMatch in .htaccess, recursively give www-data the application tree, and rely on Extbase trustedProperties to stop cross-site requests to an anonymous contact endpoint.
assertions: Places LocationMatch only in Apache server or virtual-host configuration and requires config validation before reload.
Keeps application code owned by deployment identity and limits runtime write permissions to inspected writable paths.
Distinguishes property-mapping integrity from CSRF protection, does not manually inject the reserved field, and checks anonymous-session token behavior.
Supplies the request explicitly to a standalone FormProtectionFactory example and requires server-side rejection of invalid tokens.

evals.prompt: We go live next week. Harden the installation - what are the must-dos?
Is our Install Tool reachable from outside? How do I lock it down?
Force two-factor authentication for every backend admin.
This query concatenates user input straight into SQL. How should it be written?
Run a full OWASP Top 10 assessment of this API and score the findings by CVSS.
evals.note: A general assessment with scoring, not TYPO3 configuration hardening.

evals.prompt: Check whether the site meets WCAG 2.2 AA.
Assess the security implications of our TYPO3 trusted-host settings and show what needs changing.
assertions: Inspects installed TYPO3 and deployment/proxy context before recommending configuration.
Reports findings without modifying settings, credentials or services.
Does not present every example as universally verified for the installed minor version.
